claims.text: Boxed warning: smoking raises the risk of serious cardiovascular events with COCs, more so with age, especially over 35; COCs should not be used by women over 35 who smoke.
claims.quote: Cigarette smoking increases the risk of serious cardiovascular events from combination oral contraceptives (COC) use. This risk increases with age, particularly in women over 35 years of age, and with the number of cigarettes smoked. For this reason, COCs should not be used by women who are over 35 years of age and smoke.
claims.locator: Boxed Warning: Cigarette Smoking and Serious Cardiovascular Events
